data.name: Holiday Inn Express Xalapa
data.address: Ignacio Zaragoza 8, Zona Centro, Centro, 91000 Xalapa-Enríquez, Ver., Mexico
data.description:
Set in a bustling commercial area, this unpretentious budget hotel is 3 km from anthropological exhibits at Museo de Antropología de Xalapa and 4 km from the planetarium at MIX - Interactive Museum of Xalapa.
Featuring bright accent walls, the relaxed rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Suites add living areas and kitchenettes.
A breakfast buffet and parking are complimentary, as is local shuttle service. Other amenities include a 24-hour gym, a business center and meeting space.
